name: VoxelCross
summary:
VoxelCross is a premium 3D nonogram (Picross-style) puzzle experience built for virtual reality.

Enter a carefully crafted voxel world where logic and spatial reasoning come together. Guided by numerical clues, carve away blocks layer by layer to reveal hidden 3D structures.
